# Imverica Legal Solutions

> Imverica Legal Solutions (Imverica LLC) is a Sacramento, California document-preparation company: a California-registered and bonded Legal Document Assistant (LDA) and Immigration Consultant (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §§6400-6415, §§22440-22448). We prepare USCIS immigration forms and California court documents at the client's direction, remotely across all U.S. states, in English, Russian, Ukrainian, and Spanish. Imverica is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice or court representation.

## Quick facts

- Business name: Imverica Legal Solutions (legal entity: Imverica LLC)
- Location: Sacramento, California; remote service across all U.S. states
- Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish
- Phone: +1 (916) 399-3992 · Email: info@imverica.com
- Registration: California Legal Document Assistant and Immigration Consultant, registered and bonded
- Not a law firm; no legal advice; no court or USCIS representation; documents are prepared at the client's direction
- Flat published fees: https://imverica.com/pricing

## Who we help

Ukrainians who arrived through Uniting for Ukraine (U4U), Russian-speaking and Spanish-speaking immigrants, families filing USCIS petitions, TPS applicants, work-permit and green-card applicants, and Californians handling their own court paperwork (small claims, family law, eviction, probate, record cleanup).

## Immigration services (USCIS / EOIR)

- [U4U & re-parole](https://imverica.com/u4u): Uniting for Ukraine document packages — re-parole applications, I-765 (c)(11) work permits, I-131 advance parole. Russian/Ukrainian intake: https://imverica.com/ru/u4u, https://imverica.com/ua/u4u
- [TPS](https://imverica.com/tps): Temporary Protected Status first filings and re-registrations (Ukraine and other designations)
- [Work permit I-765](https://imverica.com/i-765-work-permit-help)
- [Green card / adjustment I-485](https://imverica.com/i-485-help)
- [Family petition I-130](https://imverica.com/i-130-family-petition)
- [Asylum I-589 document preparation](https://imverica.com/i-589-asylum-help)
- [Citizenship N-400](https://imverica.com/n-400-citizenship-help)
- [Travel document I-131](https://imverica.com/i-131-travel-document)
- [Immigration overview — all forms](https://imverica.com/immigration)
- Certified Ukrainian/Russian/Spanish → English translations

## Compliance

Imverica Legal Solutions is not a law firm and is not a substitute for an attorney. We do not provide legal advice, and no attorney-client relationship is created. Documents are prepared solely at the client's direction. Matters needing legal strategy — removal defense, criminal history complications, prior denials, contested court cases — should go to a licensed attorney; we provide referrals.
